label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
**Subject: I'm okay ❤️ (please read and pass on)**

Hi everyone,

First things first: **I'm safe.** Marmalade is safe. Everyone in our building got out.

My phone hasn't stopped since Saturday night, and I'm so sorry if I haven't replied to you yet. I've read every message, mostly while crying. I'm just too tired to answer everyone one by one, so I'm putting it all in one place. Please feel free to forward this to anyone who's been asking.

**What happened (the short version)**

At about 11:40pm on Saturday 7 November, a fire started in one of the ground floor flats at Lindale Court on Station Road in Obs. It wasn't my flat. I'm on the second floor. There are 14 flats in our building and every single person got out. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home the same night, thank God.

The fire department thinks it was probably an electrical fault, but they're still investigating, so I'm not going to guess. Please don't ask me for details I don't have.

The only reason I woke up is Uncle Faizel, our neighbour, who went down our floor banging on every single door in his vest and slippers. I honestly don't know what would have happened without him. If you ever meet that man, please shake his hand.

I grabbed my phone and Marmalade and that's literally it. Marmalade then hid under a car for two hours, so that was its own adventure, but she's fine now and very offended by everything.

My flat is pretty much gone. It's smoke and water everywhere, and the ceiling came down in the lounge. The landlord says nobody can go back in for at least six weeks, and realistically I'll need to find a new place.

I'm staying with my sister in Rondebosch for now and I'm being very well looked after.

**What I actually need**

I'm going to be honest here, because so many of you have asked "what can I do?" and I'd rather you know than guess.

1. **Help with a deposit for a new place.** This is the big one. (More on the fundraiser below.)
2. **School shoes and work clothes.** Shoes size 6, clothes size 34. Just practical stuff I can wear to work and get finger paint on.
3. **A laptop, if anyone has an old one that still works.** All my lesson planning was on mine and it's gone. It doesn't need to be fancy, it just needs to turn on and open Word. If you have one lying in a cupboard, please let me or Zinhle know.

**What I don't need (please!)**

- **More clothes in general.** I have SO many already, more than I had before the fire honestly. Anything extra I'm passing on to the other families from the building, because some of them lost everything too. If you've been wanting to donate clothes, please think of them rather than me.
- **Food.** My sister's freezer is completely full. I promise I'm eating.

**The fundraiser (the real one)**

My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me. This is the ONLY real fundraiser:

👉 **backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**

The target is R25 000, mainly for the deposit and replacing basics. When I checked this morning it was already at R11 400, which I can't even process.

I'll be honest, I really hate asking for help and I feel weird about having a fundraiser at all. Zinhle basically told me to shut up and accept it, so here I am, accepting it. Please don't feel any pressure. If you can't give money, sharing the link or just sending a kind message has meant more than you know.

**⚠️ PLEASE READ: there is a FAKE fund going around**

A few people have sent me a page called **"Thandi Fire Relief"** on some other site, and there's also a **WhatsApp going around asking people to EFT money into a Capitec account.**

**That is NOT me.** I have nothing to do with it. I've reported it, but it's still out there.

So to be really clear:
- The only real fundraiser is Zinhle's BackaBuddy link above.
- I will never message you asking you to EFT money into a bank account.
- If you get a message like that, please don't pay. Report it, and if you can, send people the real link instead.

It makes me so angry that someone would use a fire where people could have died to scam people, but let's not let them win.

**For the Little Acorns families**

To my Ladybirds parents, and everyone at Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray: thank you. Truly.

I know some of you are worried about the end of year concert, so: **the concert on 27 November is still happening.** Don't worry.

I did take home all the concert stuff to laminate, which means the 22 crowns and the kids' handprint banner are gone. I'm not going to lie, the banner one hurts a bit. But I promise you, **the Ladybirds will have crowns.** We'll make it work. We might even make a new banner, and the kids will probably think it's the best thing ever.

**I'm back at school on Wednesday.** One small request: please don't make a big thing of it in front of the kids. They're four and five, and I don't want them worried or scared about fires. I just want things to feel normal for them. A quiet hug at the gate is more than enough. Honestly, being back with them is the thing I'm looking forward to most.

And to the mom who dropped a bag of clothes at my sister's gate at 7am on Sunday without even knocking: I know it was you, and I cried for about half an hour. Thank you.

**Thank you, everyone**

People have been amazing. Friends, neighbours, school families, people I've never met who got this forwarded from someone's aunt. I've cried at basically every message, in a good way.

The thing I keep coming back to is that furniture can be replaced. Clothes, books, the couch, even the laptop. All of that can be sorted. But everyone got out, Uncle Faizel woke us up, and Marmalade is sitting on my sister's bed right now judging me. That's what matters.

**One last thing:** I'm going to be really slow on replies, comments and DMs for a while. Please don't be offended if I don't answer. I'm reading everything, I just don't have the energy to reply to it all right now. It really isn't personal.

If you want to help, the best things you can do are:
- Share the real BackaBuddy link: **backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court**
- Warn people about the fake "Thandi Fire Relief" page and the Capitec WhatsApp
- Send this letter on to anyone who's been asking about me

Thank you for looking after me. I'm okay. I'm going to be okay.

All my love,
Thandi (and Marmalade 🐱)

---

A couple of small things. I left out your flat number and your sister's exact address, since this will reach strangers. Also, today is Wednesday the 11th, so if you mean next Wednesday, you might want to write "Wednesday 18 November" so the parents aren't confused.
